decisions.question: May the reminder SMS name the patient and show the date of birth?
options: Allow it, with the SMS vendor under a BAA
Send only the clinic name and time
decisions.recommendation: Send only the clinic name and time; nothing in the ticket needs the patient name.
decisions.why: Which patient data may go to a third party is a compliance call, not a code fix the author can make.
decisions.verified: read remind() and the smsClient wrapper

items.what: The reminder SMS now carries the full name and date of birth, and the same text is written to the info log.
items.why: Patient data goes to the SMS provider and into application logs, which are not meant to hold PHI.
items.ask: Drop the message body from the info log line and log the visit id instead.
items.verified: read remind() and the logger config

reply: Thanks. Please drop the body from the log line; I will decide what the SMS may say.
